# PTS

 The Fallout 76 PTS (Public Test Server) is Bethesda's official public test server for Fallout 76. New features are tested here in the beta stage and players can leave their feedback in the Bethesda Discord. A PTS is usually available parallel to the current live season. The characters from the live game are transferred at the beginning of each test phase and deleted again after the test. PTS rewards or items will not be carried over to the live game. In this category you will find articles that revolve around PTS content, patch notes and data mining.
